# Property Expert

> Premium real estate listing and discovery platform for luxury apartments, villas, commercial spaces, and penthouses.

Property Expert connects property buyers and investors with curated premium real estate developments in top Indian cities including Udaipur, Jaipur, and Mumbai.

## Features
- **Project Discovery**: Explore luxury residential and commercial properties with verified listings, high-resolution galleries, amenities, floor plans, and pricing.
- **Search & Filter**: Search real estate by status (Ongoing, Completed, Upcoming), category (Apartment, Villa, Commercial, Penthouse), and city locations.
- **Direct Enquiries**: Submit inquiries for detailed brochures, site visits, and personalized consultations directly through the platform.

## Navigation Links
- [Home](http://localhost:3000/): Featured projects, prime locations, and category showcases.
- [Projects](http://localhost:3000/projects): Full catalog of available properties with sorting and filters.
- [About Us](http://localhost:3000/about): Company background, mission, values, and leadership.
- [Contact](http://localhost:3000/contact): Direct contact details, inquiry form, and office location.
